component_definition: Use each filled F.Cu gr_circle source feature physical_contact_group from crop_circle_sources.source_scene. This is the connected component of original same-layer F.Cu source geometries under exact geometry intersects across the full ORG board; it is a geometric copper-contact relation, not an electrical-net or component-package identity. Count only unique filled circles intersecting the fixed review viewport as group members.
singleton_rule: A circle whose original whole-board F.Cu physical-contact component contains only that one in-viewport unique circle remains its exact source core, round and unchanged.
multi_circle_rule: Run the T01 shared-diameter-class process only on in-viewport circles belonging to an original physical-contact component containing at least two in-viewport unique circles. Select the largest source-radius circle in each component, stable source-ID tie-break, as that component round priority. Other members are circular growth candidates clipped by actual ORG copper and accepted earlier candidates.
construction_order: All round priorities first in source-ID order, then remaining selected circles in crop source centroid Y,X,ID order. Dynamic and frozen-neighbor controls share the same targets and priorities.
square_guided_recess: None designated for this crop. Do not transfer old-crop site annotations or infer a recess rule from EDIT.
